notes: curated: ie.json#tscee_prsia_rate2 | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: '1/6' from 2023-01-01 | DERIVE, and the only one Ireland has — the taper rate of the PRSI Class A credit. The law states the reduction in words, 'one-sixth of the amount by which weekly earnings exceed the threshold', and EUROMOD stores the arithmetic '1/6'; a correct proposal has to turn the words into the fraction, which is the whole point of the rung. corpus_available: false — the tapered credit was introduced in 2016 and lives in an amendment to SWCA 2005 s.13, while the ingested consolidation carries only the original version (validity ends 2022-01-01, no mention of a credit or of the EUR 352.01 threshold).
